title: Discovering Programmatic Policies from Reinforcement Learning-Based Traffic Signal Controllers
abstract: arXiv:2611.19951v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Traffic signal control (TSC) is critical for mitigating urban congestion. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has achieved strong performance by learning adaptive policies from traffic observations, but learned neural controllers are often opaque, structurally complex, and difficult to generalize across scenarios. We propose PPL-TSC, a programmatic policy learning framework that distills compact and human-readable TSC policies from DRL teachers. PPL-TSC formulates policy learning as an evolutionary search over phase utility functions (PUFs), which score candidate signal phases and select the highest-utility phase for execution. Each generation consists of four steps: policy generation, policy review, policy calibration, and policy evaluation. In the generation step, a large language model (LLM) acts as a semantics-aware evolutionary operator to propose and refine candidate PUFs. Generated PUFs are screened through explicit checks for syn

translated_title: 从基于强化学习的交通信号控制器中发现程序化策略
translated_abstract: 交通信号控制（TSC）对于缓解城市拥堵至关重要。深度强化学习（DRL）通过从交通观测中学习自适应策略已取得优异性能，但学习到的神经控制器往往不透明、结构复杂，且难以在不同场景间泛化。我们提出了PPL-TSC，一个程序化策略学习框架，它从DRL教师策略中提炼出紧凑且人类可读的TSC策略。PPL-TSC将策略学习表述为对相位效用函数（PUFs）的进化搜索，该函数对候选信号相位进行评分并选择效用最高的相位执行。每一代包含四个步骤：策略生成、策略审查、策略校准和策略评估。在生成步骤中，大语言模型（LLM）充当具有语义感知能力的进化算子，提出并改进候选PUF。生成的PUF通过显式检查进行筛选……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: PPL-TSC是一个程序化策略学习框架，利用大语言模型作为语义感知的进化算子，从深度强化学习教师策略中提炼出紧凑、人类可读且易于泛化的交通信号控制策略。
en_tdlr: PPL-TSC is a programmatic policy learning framework that uses an LLM as a semantics-aware evolutionary operator to distill compact, human-readable, and generalizable traffic signal control policies from DRL teachers.
